head: pan
notes: Zip repro kit for GM 9428715 (68-72 rear window lower pin screws) says 6-32 pan head; length not given. Single source. Corvette Pacifica also lists the rear window wedge plate screw kit as GM 9428715, no size.

sources.title: 1968-1972 Corvette Rear Window Lower Pin Screws (4) (GM Part 9428715) - Zip
sources.quote: Includes (4) 6-32 pan head screws for mounting removable rear window lower pins to aluminum window frame. ... OE GM PART #: 9428715
